Required: Description, TicketTitle. Optional: EndUserEmail, EndUserFirstName, EndUserID (plus 8 more).

tools.name: tickets_put
tools.description: Updates an existing ticket. Requires the ticket ID. The following fields are editable: Ticket Title (TicketTitle) Ticket Status (TicketStatus) Ticket Type (TicketType) Ticket Priority (TicketPriority) Ticket Impact (TicketImpact) Assigned Technician ID (TechnicianContactID). Required: ticketId. Optional: TechnicianContactID, TechnicianEmail, TicketImpact (plus 4 more). Returns the new Result.

tools.name: tickets_comments_ticket-add-to-ticket-async
tools.description: Creates a new comment. Requires comment text and (TechnicianCommentDetails object or EnduserCommentDetails object) and optionally the comment Timestamp in UTC. If you wish to create a new contact comment for the ticket then you need to provide: EnduserCommentDetails object with existing enduser contact ID If you wish to create a new technicain internal comment for the ticket then you need to provide: TechnicianCommentDetails object with existing technician ID, and IsInternal set to true If you wish to create a new technicain comment for the ticket then you need to provide: TechnicianCommentDetails object with existing technician ID, and IsInternal set to false. Required: ticketId. Optional: CommentText, CommentTimestampUTC, EnduserCommentDetails (plus 1 more).
